# @erp/miniapp-ui — LLM overview

- alert-dialog — Modal dialog that interrupts the user to confirm a destructive or
- alert — Static, inline banner for surfacing a status, warning, or error message
- aspect-ratio — Constrains a child (typically an image or video) to a fixed width/height
- avatar — Circular user/entity image with a text fallback, shown while the image
- badge — Small inline label for status, category, or count.
- breadcrumb — Trail of links showing the user's location in a hierarchy. Compose with
- button — Primary interactive control for actions and navigation.
- calendar — Date picker grid built on `react-day-picker`. Supports `mode="single"`,
- card — Container for grouping related content and actions. Compose with
- checkbox — Tri-state input for toggling a single value on/off (or indeterminate).
- collapsible — Show/hide a section of content triggered by a control, with open state
- dialog — Modal overlay for focused tasks or content that interrupts the current
- drawer — Panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (`side`: right/left/top/
- dropdown-menu — Menu of actions/options revealed by a trigger. Compose with
- empty — Placeholder state for a list/section with no data (empty search results,
- field — Layout wrapper for a single form control plus its label/description/error,
- hover-card — Rich preview shown on hover/focus of a trigger (e.g. a user mention),
- input — Single-line text input. A thin styled wrapper around the native `<input>`
- label — Accessible label for a form control. Clicking it focuses/activates the
- pagination — Page-number navigation for splitting long lists across pages. Compose
- popover — Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, for supplementary controls
- progress — Horizontal bar showing completion progress toward a task, 0-100 via
- radio-group — Set of mutually exclusive options; exactly one RadioGroupItem can be
- scroll-area — Scrollable viewport with custom, cross-browser-consistent scrollbars
- select — Dropdown for choosing one value from a list, styled to replace the native
- separator — Visual divider between content, horizontal or vertical via `orientation`.
- sheet — Panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (`side`: right/left/top/
- sidebar — Root context provider for the Sidebar composite: tracks expanded/
- skeleton — Pulsing placeholder shape shown while content is loading. Size it with
- slider — Drag control for selecting one value, or a range with two thumbs when
- sonner — Toast notification host, styled to match library tokens. Mount once near
- spinner — Indeterminate loading indicator (spinning icon). Size via `className`
- switch — Binary on/off toggle, typically for an immediately-applied setting.
- table — Styled `<table>` wrapper with a horizontal-scroll container. Compose with
- tabs — Switches between panels of content under a shared set of triggers.
- textarea — Multi-line text input that grows with content (`field-sizing: content`).

- toggle — Two-state (on/off) button, e.g. for a formatting option like bold/italic.

## Components (patterns)
- app-sidebar — Dreams ERP–aligned application sidebar.
- confirm-dialog — Ready-made AlertDialog for confirming an action, with an optional trigger
- date-picker — Single-date picker — Popover + Calendar composition (shadcn Date Picker
- layout — Page-level heading row: title + optional description on the left,
- search-field — Text input pre-configured for search: `type="search"` with a leading
- sortable-list — Vertical sortable list — HTML5 drag-and-drop via a handle.
- states — Stack of skeleton placeholders for a loading list (`rows` count).

## Components (charts)
- bar-chart — Lightweight CSS/div-based bar chart for dashboards — one or more series
- donut-chart — Lightweight SVG donut/ring chart for showing proportions of a whole, with
- line-chart — Lightweight SVG sparkline/trend chart — a single-series polyline with an

## Foundations
- accessibility — Mini apps phải dùng được bằng bàn phím, reader, và đủ tương phản trong portal sáng.
- animation — Motion hỗ trợ hierarchy và feedback, không trang trí.
- colors — Semantic color tokens cho surface, text, action, status. Tất cả map qua `:root` → `@theme inline` → utility Tailwind (`bg-primary`, `text-destructive`, …).
- elevation — Phân tầng bề mặt bằng màu + border trước; shadow dùng sparingly cho overlay.
- radius — Bo góc thống nhất cho control, card và overlay.
- responsive — Mini apps chạy trong ERP shell: desktop sidebar + mobile webview. Layout phải dùng được cả hai.
- spacing — Nhịp khoảng cách nhất quán giữa layout, form và list.
- typography — Hệ chữ thống nhất, đọc tốt trên portal ERP (desktop + mobile webview).

## Conventions
- accessibility — Follow [foundations/accessibility](/?path=/docs/foundations-accessibility--docs). PR checklist in review.md.
- api — - Browser talks to **your** mini-app API routes; API keys stay server-side.
- constants — Static, serializable values used by pages and shell. Prefer `src/constants/*.ts`.
- empty — See [patterns/empty](/?path=/docs/patterns-empty--docs). Distinguish empty vs error vs forbidden.
- error-handling — Load → `ErrorState`. Mutation → toast + field errors. Permission → `PermissionState`.
- folder — Recommended mini-app layout:
- hooks — - Data hooks wrap React Query (or app equivalent).
- imports — ```ts
- lib — Shared non-UI code under `src/lib/`.
- loading — See [patterns/loading](/?path=/docs/patterns-loading--docs).
- naming — - Components: PascalCase files only if local feature components; library stays kebab-case files.
- pages — `page.tsx` stays a **Server Component**. Do not put `"use client"` on route files.
- performance — - Import only what you use from `@erp/miniapp-ui` (ESM tree-shake).
- react-query — - Query keys: `[resource, params]`.
- review — - [ ] Uses `@erp/miniapp-ui` — no forked Button/Input
- state — - Server state: React Query.
- styling — Rules for mini apps consuming `@erp/miniapp-ui`. Library internals follow the same

## Patterns (guides)
- app-sidebar — Dreams ERP–aligned application navigation. Pass a nav list (`items` + `activeId`) — the library owns spacing, section titles, and active styles so mini apps stay in sync.
- confirmation — Irreversible or costly actions (delete, reject, revoke).
- crud — List → create/edit/delete domain records.
- dashboard — Grid of `StatisticCard` + `DashboardCard` panels. Charts: `BarChart` / `DonutChart` / `LineChart` — pass data only (see [chart-page recipe](/?path=/docs/recipes-chart-page--docs)).
- date-picker — Pick a single date or a date range via Popover + Calendar ([shadcn Date Picker](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/date-picker) composition). Pass `value` / `onChange`; the library handles trigger + calendar UI.
- dialog — Short, focused tasks without leaving the page.
- empty — `EmptyState` when the collection is legitimately empty (not an error).
- error — Use `ErrorState` with optional `onRetry`. Toast (`sonner`) for mutation failures that keep the form mounted.
- filter — Multi-field filters that would crowd the toolbar.
- forms — Collecting or editing structured data.
- list-detail — - Mobile: list page → detail page/route.
- loading — | Situation | Pattern |
- not-found — `NotFoundState` for missing ids / deep links.
- pagination — Server- or client-paged collections.
- permission — `PermissionState` when IAM/scopes deny the view or action.
- search — Filtering a list by free text.
- sortable-list — Vertical list reordering via HTML5 drag-and-drop (handle only). No third-party DnD package.
- table — Dense tabular data with clear columns.
- upload — Native `input type="file"` styled via `Button asChild` + `Label`, or dropzone in the app.
- wizard — `Tabs` (controlled step index) or numbered header + `FormStack` per step + Back/Next `Button`s.

## Recipes
- approve-request — Approve a pending request with optional note.
- chart-page — Compose dashboard charts from `@erp/miniapp-ui` — **do not** hand-roll bar/donut/line markup in the mini app.
- create-user — Admin creates a user record.
- crud — Full list + create + edit + delete for one object.
- data-table — `Table` + `SearchField` + `Pagination` + row actions via `DropdownMenu`.
- delete-user — Destructive delete with `ConfirmDialog`.
- edit-user — Edit existing user; prefill form from loader.
- filter-drawer — Toolbar `Button` opens `Drawer` with filter `FormStack`; Apply writes URL/query state.
- login — Authenticate the mini-app user (initData or form) and land on home.
- profile — View/edit the current user profile.
- reject-request — Reject with required reason.
- report-page — `PageHeader` + date filters + `StatisticCard` row + export `Button`.
- search-page — `SearchField` + results list + empty/loading/error states.
- setting-page — Grouped settings with `Tabs` or accordion sections; save per section or global Save.
- upload-file — See [patterns/upload](/?path=/docs/patterns-upload--docs). Show filename + progress + toast.
